title: What's new in v2.11.4
summary: Malware phones home once, and every site blocks the host.

steps.title: Outbound Threat Blocking
steps.listLabel: Malware phones home once, and every site blocks the host
steps.body:
CyberSecure blocks the one device, port, and connection it caught, for 5 minutes. Network Optimizer now blocks the malicious host itself, for every device on every site sharing blocks, within seconds of the alert.

You'll find these marked **Outbound** in **Threat Intelligence - Blocking**, with the device and the signature that caught it.
